title: Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability Dean’s Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability, Stanford University
field: Sustainability, Earth, oceans, energy, civil and environmental engineering
about: Postdoctoral fellowship of up to two years at the Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability, starting September 2027, in Earth, oceans, energy, civil and environmental engineering and emerging sustainability fields. Applicants need a recent PhD (within three years) and at most two years of postdoc experience.
requirements: PhD conferred by the start of the award term and within the last three years
At most two years of prior postdoctoral experience
Non-U.S. scholars must be eligible for a J-1 visa (sponsored by Stanford)
